## Problem Description

What problem are you trying to solve? Is it related to the routing policy, the Claude Code or
Codex integration, configuration, or something else?

## Desired Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or examples here. If relevant, note whether this fits within the
existing module boundaries (see `AGENTS.md`) — e.g. a policy change belongs in `policy.py` /
`config.py`, not in the proxy.
